boundaryZh: 本注册表说明项目实际采用或参考的标准、数据集、方法文献与内部协议。列入不表示 EcoMOF-AI 已通过标准认证、完成外部独立验证或获得来源机构认可。
boundaryEn: This registry records standards, datasets, method papers, and internal protocols actually adopted or consulted by the project. Inclusion does not mean that EcoMOF-AI is standards-certified, externally validated, or endorsed by the source organization.

modules.summaryZh: 国标与 ISO 标准用于组织目标与范围、功能单位、清单、影响评价、解释和局限；MOF 文献用于识别路线与溶剂热点，不直接移植数值。
modules.summaryEn: Chinese and ISO standards organize goal and scope, functional unit, inventory, impact assessment, interpretation, and limitations. MOF studies inform route and solvent hotspots without transferring their numerical inventories.
modules.boundaryZh: 当前为早期筛选和情景比较，不是经第三方审查的完整 LCA，也不作公开比较断言。
modules.boundaryEn: The current implementation supports early screening and scenario comparison; it is not a third-party-reviewed full LCA and does not support public comparative assertions.

references.title: GB/T 24040-2008 环境管理 生命周期评价 原则与框架
references.sourceLabelZh: 国家标准全文公开系统
references.projectUseZh: 采用目标与范围、LCI、LCIA、解释、报告和局限的总体框架。
references.projectUseEn: Adopts the overall structure for goal and scope, LCI, LCIA, interpretation, reporting, and limitations.

references.title: GB/T 24044-2008 环境管理 生命周期评价 要求与指南
references.sourceLabelZh: 国家标准全文公开系统
references.projectUseZh: 用于约束数据质量、分配、敏感性、解释和报告边界。
references.projectUseEn: Constrains data quality, allocation, sensitivity, interpretation, and reporting boundaries.

references.title: ISO 14040:2006 Environmental management — Life cycle assessment — Principles and framework
references.projectUseZh: 与 GB/T 24040-2008 对照使用，保持生命周期评价阶段和术语一致。
references.projectUseEn: Used alongside GB/T 24040-2008 to align LCA stages and terminology.

references.title: ISO 14044:2006 Environmental management — Life cycle assessment — Requirements and guidelines
references.projectUseZh: 与 GB/T 24044-2008 对照使用，约束要求、数据质量和解释边界。
references.projectUseEn: Used alongside GB/T 24044-2008 for requirements, data quality, and interpretation boundaries.

references.title: Life-cycle assessment as a tool for eco-design of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs)
references.projectUseZh: 参考 MOF-74 摇篮到门边界及合成、清洗溶剂热点；不移植原文清单数值。
references.projectUseEn: References the cradle-to-gate boundary and synthesis/washing solvent hotspots for MOF-74; source inventory values are not transferred.

references.title: Techno-economic Analysis of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Hydrogen and Natural Gas Storage
references.projectUseZh: 参考规模化生产的产率、溶剂、回收率和成本敏感性结构。
references.projectUseEn: References yield, solvent, recovery, and cost sensitivity structure for scaled production.

references.title: Comparative life cycle assessment on zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8) production for CO2 capture
references.projectUseZh: 参考按 1 kg 材料比较合成路线和洗涤溶剂热点的方法。
references.projectUseEn: References comparison of synthesis routes and washing-solvent hotspots per 1 kg material.

references.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Metal-Organic Frameworks: Sustainability Study of Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework-67
references.projectUseZh: 参考溶剂热与反应挤出路线的尺度化比较方式。
references.projectUseEn: References scale-up comparison between solvothermal and reactive-extrusion routes.

references.title: Life cycle assessment of CO2 capture through pressure swing adsorption using MOF-74
references.projectUseZh: 参考把材料生产、使用、再生、产率与捕集能耗纳入情景敏感性。
references.projectUseEn: References scenario sensitivity spanning production, use, regeneration, yield, and capture energy.

references.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Silver, Copper, and Zinc-Based Metal-Organic Framework Products for Industry-Scale Production and Future Horizons
references.projectUseZh: 参考实验室与工业放大、闭环回收和过程强化的热点拆分；不移植数值。
references.projectUseEn: References laboratory/industrial scale-up, closed-loop recovery, and process-intensification hotspots without transferring values.

references.title: Life cycle assessment of a layered metal-organic framework for supercapacitor applications
references.projectUseZh: 参考 Cu3(HHTP)2 案例中的产率、洗涤溶剂和回收率敏感性，不用于替代其他候选清单。
references.projectUseEn: References yield, washing-solvent, and recovery sensitivity for Cu3(HHTP)2 without substituting inventories for other candidates.

modules.summaryZh: CoRE MOF 2024 是当前结构主库，FAIR-MOFs 通过完全一致的 CSD refcode 补充合成条件和部分属性；FAIR 原则用于来源设计。
modules.summaryEn: CoRE MOF 2024 is the active structural corpus. FAIR-MOFs augments synthesis conditions and selected properties only through exact CSD-refcode joins; FAIR principles guide provenance design.
modules.boundaryZh: 数据库收录、计算属性或 refcode 匹配不等于单篇论文的实验性能声明已核验。
modules.boundaryEn: Database inclusion, computed properties, or refcode matching do not verify experimental performance claims in an article.

references.title: CoRE MOF 2024 v1.1 dataset
references.projectUseZh: 作为 9,835 条 CSD-modified CR 结构记录和核心结构字段的当前主库。
references.projectUseEn: Serves as the active corpus of 9,835 CSD-modified CR structure records and core structural fields.

references.title: CoRE MOF DB: A curated experimental metal-organic framework database with machine-learned properties for integrated material-process screening
references.projectUseZh: 用于解释 CoRE MOF DB 的整理范围、数据性质与材料—过程筛选语境。
references.projectUseEn: Provides the curation scope, data character, and material-process screening context for CoRE MOF DB.

references.title: FAIR-MOFs: A Comprehensive Database for Accelerating the Discovery and Synthesis of Metal-Organic Frameworks
references.projectUseZh: 仅在 CSD refcode 完全匹配时补充合成条件、DOI 和部分物化性质；保留原来源和许可证。
references.projectUseEn: Adds synthesis conditions, DOI links, and selected physicochemical properties only for exact CSD-refcode matches while retaining source and licence.

references.title: The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
references.projectUseZh: 用于字段可查找、可访问、可互操作、可复用及机器可读来源设计；FAIR 原则本身不是认证标准。
references.projectUseEn: Guides findable, accessible, interoperable, reusable, and machine-actionable provenance; the FAIR principles are not themselves a certification standard.

modules.summaryZh: IAST、吸附术语和等温线模型文献用于约束计算与表达；项目另设配对等温线、温度、压力和来源一致性门槛。
modules.summaryEn: IAST, adsorption terminology, and isotherm-model literature constrain calculations and reporting; the project adds paired-isotherm, temperature, pressure, and source-consistency gates.
modules.boundaryZh: IAST 预测不等于混合气穿透实验；Qst、Henry 亲和与代理选择性必须与来源报告值分开。
modules.boundaryEn: IAST prediction is not a mixed-gas breakthrough experiment. Qst, Henry affinity, and proxy selectivity must remain separate from source-reported values.

references.title: Thermodynamics of mixed-gas adsorption
references.projectUseZh: 作为 IAST 的原始方法依据；仅在同温、同材料的成对纯组分等温线与有效拟合范围内计算。
references.projectUseEn: Serves as the original IAST method reference; calculations require paired pure-component isotherms for the same material and temperature within the fitted range.

references.title: Physisorption of gases, with special reference to the evaluation of surface area and pore size distribution
references.projectUseZh: 参考物理吸附、比表面积、孔径和等温线解释术语，不据此替代原始实验条件。
references.projectUseEn: References terminology for physisorption, surface area, pore size, and isotherm interpretation without replacing source experimental conditions.

references.title: The adsorption of gases on plane surfaces of glass, mica and platinum
references.projectUseZh: 作为 Langmuir 等温线模型的历史方法参考；拟合优度和压力范围必须随记录报告。
references.projectUseEn: Provides the historical method reference for the Langmuir isotherm; fit quality and pressure range must be reported per record.

modules.summaryZh: 催化模块采用 DOI 身份、反应条件、数值定位、活性相证据和可比性门槛组成的内部记录协议，并以十篇已登记论文作为种子证据集。
modules.summaryEn: Catalysis uses an internal record protocol spanning DOI identity, reaction conditions, claim location, active-phase evidence, and comparability, with ten registered papers as its seed evidence corpus.
modules.boundaryZh: 当前不存在适用于所有催化任务的单一外部金标准。论文 DOI 核验不等于反应数值、活性相或跨论文可比性已全部核验。
modules.boundaryEn: There is no single external gold standard for every catalysis task. DOI verification does not verify every reaction value, active phase, or cross-paper comparison.

references.title: EcoMOF-AI Catalysis Reaction Record Protocol v1
references.projectUseZh: 统一 DOI、反应体系、条件、性能指标、活性相证据、字段来源和可比性状态。
references.projectUseEn: Normalizes DOI, reaction system, conditions, performance metrics, active-phase evidence, field sources, and comparability status.

references.title: CO2-to-formate catalysis DOI seed corpus
references.sourceLabelZh: 项目催化文献核验中心
references.projectUseZh: 作为反应记录和字段核验的种子文献集合；每条记录仍按字段状态单独判定。
references.projectUseEn: Serves as the seed literature corpus for reaction records and field verification; each record remains subject to field-level status checks.

references.title: Organic Acid scoring and rerun protocol V3.9.10
references.sourceLabelZh: 项目锁定规则与重跑记录
references.projectUseZh: 锁定路径权重、结构规则、FAIR-MOFs 合成可达性和证据边界；输出是候选优先级，不是实验活性结论。
references.projectUseEn: Locks pathway weights, structural rules, FAIR-MOFs synthesis accessibility, and evidence boundaries; outputs candidate priority rather than experimental activity conclusions.

modules.summaryZh: 算法中心采用拆分、泄漏审计、交叉验证、bootstrap、稳健性和可解释性作为内部诊断；当前标签库尚缺逐条 DOI 和全文定位。
modules.summaryEn: The algorithm center uses splitting, leakage audit, cross-validation, bootstrap, robustness, and explainability as internal diagnostics. The current label corpus still lacks per-label DOI and full-text claim locations.
modules.boundaryZh: 现有 150 条整理标签和 80 条留出记录只能支持内部协议基准与软件流程检查，不能称为外部独立实验验证。模型数值保留，但解释必须受此边界约束。
modules.boundaryEn: The 150 curated labels and 80 held-out records support only an internal protocol benchmark and software workflow checks, not independent external experimental validation. Model metrics remain visible but must be interpreted within this boundary.

references.title: EcoMOF-AI internal curated-label benchmark protocol
references.projectUseZh: 保留已计算的模型指标、拆分、泄漏和稳健性诊断；标签未完成 DOI/全文逐条复核前，不对外宣称真实实验基准。
references.projectUseEn: Retains computed model metrics, splits, leakage, and robustness diagnostics; no external real-experiment benchmark claim is made until per-label DOI/full-text verification is complete.

references.title: Curated organic-acid label corpus v2
references.projectUseZh: 150 条内部整理标签用于流程测试；sourceDoi 为空且数值待全文复核，因此不作为 DOI 支撑的 ground truth。
references.projectUseEn: Uses 150 internally curated labels for pipeline testing; sourceDoi is empty and values await full-text review, so they are not DOI-backed ground truth.

references.title: EcoMOF-AI model robustness report v1
references.projectUseZh: 记录交叉验证、重复排序、bootstrap、置信区间、泛化差距和高过拟合风险；不改变标签证据等级。
references.projectUseEn: Records cross-validation, repeated ranking, bootstrap, confidence intervals, generalization gap, and high overfitting risk without upgrading label evidence.
